[RFCS.11.4] All atoms between a matching begin/end `RuleFireAnnotation` pair
are attributed to that activation — the `FactEmit` atoms the rule produced
([RFCS.6a.1]) and every other atom its firing emitted.  `RuleFireAnnotation.rule_name` and
`RuleFireAnnotation.timetag` on the preceding begin atom are the provenance
for those atoms — and, being the same `(timetag, rule_name)` the
bracketed `CallIssued` records, resolve the `CallIssued`↔`RuleFireAnnotation` join ([RFCS.15.2]).
